```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run Claude Code for triage
        id: claude
        uses: anthropic/claude-code@v1
        with:
          model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          prompt: |
            You are an issue triage assistant. Analyze the following issue and suggest labels to apply. Output a JSON object with a key "labels" containing an array of label names. The issue title and body are:
            Title: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
            Body: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
          max_tokens: 200
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Parse labels
        id: parse
        run: |
          echo "labels=$(echo '${{ steps.claude.outputs.output }}' | jq -r '.labels | join(\",\")')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

      - name: Apply labels
        uses: peter-evans/label@v5
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          labels: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.labels }}
```
